name: dolibarr
description: Dolibarr ERP CRM is a modern software package to manage your company or foundation's activity (contacts, suppliers, invoices, orders, stocks, agenda, accounting, ...). it's an open source Web application (written in PHP) designed for businesses of any sizes, foundations and freelancers.

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
FIX: #30326 agenda assigned resources not shown on the event card (#41247)
FIX: #39239 The user of the last change of a MO was unknown after a status change (#41903)
FIX: #39456 a supplier credit note can hold a positive line (#41160)
FIX: #39533 Store lastUpdate when it is empty, or the monthly leave credit never runs (#41349)
FIX: #39771 TakePOS: free zone amount lost its decimals with a comma as decimal separator (#41742)
FIX: #40158 Undefined array key warnings in the bank journal (#41904)
FIX: #40432 Strip tab and newline from doc_ref in FEC export (#42097)
FIX: #40487 Saving a contact wipes its civility when MAIN_USE_TITLE_FOR_CONTACT is off (#41501)
FIX: #41246 Product related items page fails for users who cannot see all thirdparties (#41356)
FIX: #41475 Deposit or credit note with several VAT rates: cost price of each discount line (#41476)
FIX: #41689 REST API: keep the order of invoice lines sent with POST /invoices (#41690)
FIX: #41780 scripts/cron: terminate the job log line when a job is skipped by its test condition (#41781)
FIX: #41786 Vendor invoice: save the tags on creation, not on validation (#41787)
FIX: #41842 PHP warnings in Ldap::fetch() for attributes missing from the LDAP entry (#41843)
FIX: #41882 Delivery receipt PDF (storm): HTML entities in the signature boxes (#41884)
FIX: #41967 TakePOS: floor plan opens on an empty floor 0 instead of the floor with tables (#41968)
FIX: #42000 PHP warning Undefined array key "direct-download" on marketplace page (#42103)
FIX: #42045 No EPC QR code with amount 0 on fully paid invoices (#42046)
FIX: #42157 CSV export - quote only the values that need it (digits, journals and select labels) (#42159)
FIX: #42168 Invoice due date is one day early when the payment term crosses a DST change (#42176)
FIX: #42204 Add phone columns to Ticket::listeContact() for thirdparty (#42205)
FIX: a bookmark title longer than 64 characters showed a raw database error (#41286)
FIX: a category could be moved into one of its own sub-categories (#41340)
FIX: a category that contains orders, invoices or interventions could not be deleted (#41333)
FIX: Accountancy ledger PDF - account title lines wrap word by word (regression of #40790)
FIX: Add Canadian bank account fields (#41977) (#42218)
FIX: adding an object to a category without the permission on it reported a success (#41338)
FIX: add missing CSRF token on agenda setup select none link (#41944)
FIX: a disabled workstation could be deleted from its card without the permission to delete (#41273)
FIX: a failed creation of a workstation still saved links to user groups and resources (#41272)
FIX: Agenda recurring events were shifted by one hour by a daylight saving time change (#41693)
FIX: a line of a validated, approved or paid expense report could be deleted (#41463)
FIX: an MO could be consumed or produced while draft, produced or canceled (#41619)
FIX: an MO with consumed or produced lines could be set back to draft and reset (#41621)
FIX: answering No to record or cancel an inventory still recorded or canceled it (#41575)
FIX: API errors answered with HTTP 200 instead of 500/501 when the output is not buffered (#42064)
FIX: API refused for the IP answered with HTTP 200 instead of 503 when the output is not buffered (#42059)
FIX: API setup: getListOfExtrafields reads showintooltip without selecting it (#41299)
FIX: API setup: the VAT dictionary route omits einvoice_vatex (#41359)
FIX: API setup: the VAT dictionary route returns only part of the table (#41313)
FIX: API thirdparties: the VAT rate of a fixed amount discount is ignored (#41778)
FIX: API to add or remove a category of a contact was always refused to users restricted to their third parties (#41268)
FIX: API tokens not migrated on upgrade when table prefix is not llx_ (#41834)
FIX: a serial number could be added twice to a stock transfer (#41614)
